Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for our claim file. Can you confirm you're
comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened at the parking lot.
A: I was backing out of a space near the store entrance. It was a busy afternoon and the lot was pretty full. I checked
my mirrors and started reversing slowly, and then I felt a jolt as another vehicle clipped the rear of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?
A: Not really. It came from the lane beihnd the row of parked cars. I think it was moving at a normal pace, but I didn't
see it until just before it hit.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and what was your speed?
A: Yes, I had my seatbelt on. I was barely moving, maybe walking pace. I'd only just started to reverse.
Q: Did you notice any injuries right away?
A: Not immediately. I felt okay for maybe an hour, then my neck started to ache and it got stiffer over the next day. It's
mostly on the left side, and turning my head to check traffic hurts.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the next morning. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me a prescription for
a muscle relaxant and some physical therapy referrals.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Just that I'm trying to keep up with my appointments and I'm hoping to get back to normal soon.
Q: Thank you. That concludes our recording.
</page>

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
